photos.file: ISS-64 Kate Rubins checks out radish plants (1).jpg
photos.desc: Expedition 64 Flight Engineer Kate Rubins of NASA shows off radish plants growing inside the Columbus laboratory module's Advanced Plant Habitat before collecting leaf samples for analysis.

photos.file: ISS-64 Radish plants in the Plant Habitat-02 experiment (2).jpg
photos.desc: Radish plants are pictured growing for the Plant Habitat-02 experiment that could help optimize plant growth in the unique environment of space and evaluate nutrition and taste of the plants.
